canonical_source.behavior: Validate the site name and primary WordPress URL, persist the tenant-owned site profile, then reload the authoritative settings state before announcing success.

source_semantics.name: Name is required, trimmed, and limited to 150 characters.
source_semantics.url: URL must be absolute http/https; the source normalizes host casing, clears query/fragment, and resets the path to root.
source_semantics.persistence: Only site name and primary URL are changed.
source_semantics.authoritative_reread: SaveProfileAsync calls LoadAsync after UpdateSiteAsync before leaving the operation complete.
source_semantics.external_dependency: No WordPress, Connector, AI provider, or payment-provider request is made by this operation.

laravel_adaptation.tenant_isolation: The active TenantContext slug must equal the route tenant and the site write/reread both use explicit active tenant_id plus route site key.
laravel_adaptation.csrf: The route uses web middleware and the visible Blade form renders @csrf.
laravel_adaptation.locking: The active-tenant site row is locked inside a bounded DB transaction before comparison/write.
laravel_adaptation.replay: Submitting an already-normalized identical name/URL is a no-op before the authoritative reread.
laravel_adaptation.success: The success redirect is emitted only after rereading and verifying the exact persisted name and normalized URL.
laravel_adaptation.failure: Validation, permission, foreign-tenant/site, or verification failures fail closed without a fabricated success state.

security_and_truthfulness.unrelated_state_preserved: status, connection_status, health_state, credentials, executions, and provider state are not changed.
security_and_truthfulness.payment_provider: No provider call or readiness/success claim is introduced.

terminality.basis: The exact SaveProfileAsync control now has a real authenticated tenant-scoped sites.manage mutation, source-aligned input normalization, deterministic validation and failure behavior, row-locked persistence, authoritative reread verification, and focused isolation tests.
